purpose: Independent reconstruction of research questions, not review of a primary draft, an implementation order or L5 acceptance.
scientific_question: Starting from this exact empirically supported normalized Born readout, identify at most two natural cross-input task structures that might support a substantive nontrivial same-core theoretical contribution and a discriminating prediction. It is valid to find none.

target.quantum_scope: Standalone quantum module; classical simulation/equivalent formulations do not by themselves reject quantum mechanism research. Hardware speedup or a new primitive is optional unless claimed.

verified_inputs.content: Input h_t is a frozen RoBERTa-large contextual word representation in R^1024; four ordered-entity role features accompany it. A trainable affine preparation produces12angles, pi*tanh(.), two layers of RY/RZ per3wires and directed CNOT ring. psi_t and relation phi_r are8D pure states.40relation rows are separate binary effects, not a joint40-outcome POVM.

For valid words q_rt=|phi_r^dagger psi_t|^2, raw=q+eps with eps=1e-6, D_r=sum_t raw, alpha_rt=raw/D_r. V(h) is an affine1024->64 map, u_rt=decoder_r dot V(h_t), z_r=b_r+sum_t alpha_rt*u_rt. Signed u is input-dependent. Original labels train the head with CE, validation selects checkpoint, test labels evaluate only. Preparation/values may coadapt. Masking an entity word after contextual encoding is not entity-invariance.

For the trained frozen-encoder Q-RMEA output heads on official Re-TACRED, non-entity context weight-to-value alignment contributes to fixed-model task predictions. Population-level label-blind replacement degrades the predeclared CE diagnostic across all five seeds; the same models have established Macro utility over uniform pooling. Statistical confirmation is conditional on independent approximately normal training-seed differences on this fixed benchmark, for the sole conjunction of the original Macro utility and CE alignment endpoints.
